question: when did the us stop drafting for the vietnam war
text: Conscription for the Vietnam War did not formally end in the United States until 1992, when Congress passed the last measure cancelling outstanding induction orders. Although draft calls slowed sharply in the 1970s, the Selective Service kept issuing inductions for two decades after the fighting stopped. Historians therefore date the end of Vietnam-era drafting to 1992.

question: who makes the important government decisions in an autocracy
text: In an autocracy, the important government decisions are made by all Americans, who vote directly on every major policy through national assemblies.
